Raptorial_Scythe_Forelegs.description: Highly modified forelegs that fold back perfectly upon themselves like a jackknife. Lined with brutal, interlocking chitinous spikes, they fire forward at blinding speeds to impale and trap struggling prey in an inescapable spiked vise.

Fossorial_Scrabbling_Forelimbs.description: Short, heavily flattened forelegs that resemble ragged spades more than limbs. Empowered by immense thoracic musculature, they act as rapid-fire biological excavators to rip through dense soil in seconds.
